description: The ECB Data Portal is the European Central Bank's web platform for its statistics: key figures and dashboards on the euro area, financial developments, the external sector and exchange rates and banking supervision, and data on ECB interest rates, money, credit and banking, non-bank financial corporations, prices, macroeconomic and sectoral indicators, financial markets and securities, payment statistics and supervisory banking data. Data are organised into Key Data, Detailed Data, All Data and Web Services (API) layers, browsable by category, concept, geography and dataset, with a data cart, favourites, publications, methodology and a currency converter. It is run by the European Central Bank. Coverage is the euro area and EU countries; at access it showed euro area inflation of 3.2% for August 2026 and supervisory indicators such as a liquidity coverage ratio of 154.9% for Q2 2026. The portal and API are available free online; the page read does not state reuse terms. Caveats: definitions and country composition change over time, as the quick-info notes on each series show. For simulation it supplies banking, payments and market series for resilience and stress models of the euro area financial system. It is related to the ECB payments statistics record in this catalogue, one of the datasets it serves.
